params.text: Cold stone and si-lence, be-neath the frost We raise a tow-er of glass and ghost Each fra-gile win-dow will hold the dawn Hear the bells ring-ing through hol-low stone Light breaks the sha-dow we walk a-lone Burn through the glass, let the spires a-wake Sing for the walls that the storm will break High-er than sor-row, and bright as flame Call out the light by its tru-est name Burn through the glass, let the spires a-wake Shine on the ru-ins that we re-make Gold in the raf-ters, the dark-ness gone Stand in the blaze of a new-born dawn Still in the glass, the light re-mains -
a-wake will break as flame a-wake re-make is gone
